Test Objective: Verify customer portal presents 6 distinct request types upon submission.
Preconditions: User logged into JSM Customer Portal.
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Raise a Request'. 2. Inspect category dropdown menu.
Expected Result: Dropdown displays exactly 6 request types: Login/Auth, Account Access, Bug, Data Issue, Billing, Feature Request.
Actual Result: Dropdown displays all 6 request types correctly.

Test Objective: Verify mandatory field enforcement on Login / Authentication submission form.
Preconditions: User selected 'Login / Authentication' request type.
Test Steps: 1. Leave Tenant ID blank. 2. Enter summary. 3. Click Submit.
Expected Result: Form submission is blocked with red highlight on Tenant ID stating 'This field is required'.
Actual Result: Form blocked and field highlighted as expected.

Test Objective: Verify real-time Knowledge Base article deflection suggestions.
Preconditions: User on portal ticket submission page.
Test Steps: 1. Type 'reset my password' into summary box.
Expected Result: System displays top 3 KB articles matching password reset keywords below summary field.
Actual Result: KB-001 and KB-002 suggested in real-time.
Notes: KB deflection integration working as designed.

Test Objective: Verify Bulk User CSV Importer handles hyphenated email addresses.
Preconditions: CSV file containing 50 users, 4 of which have hyphens in email.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to User Importer. 2. Upload `users_import.csv`. 3. Click Execute Import.
Expected Result: All 50 users imported successfully into user table.
Actual Result: 46 users imported; 4 hyphenated email users dropped silently without error message.
Notes: Regex validation pattern excludes hyphen character. Logged BUG-001.

Test Objective: Verify ticket workflow transitions through all 5 defined states.
Preconditions: Agent logged into JSM agent portal.
Test Steps: 1. Move ticket from Open -> In Progress -> Waiting for Customer -> Escalated -> Resolved.
Expected Result: Ticket status transitions cleanly through each step without error.
Actual Result: Status updated through all 5 states successfully.

Test Objective: Verify SLA resolution timer pauses when status changes to 'Waiting for Customer'.
Preconditions: Ticket has active counting SLA timer.
Test Steps: 1. Change status to 'Waiting for Customer'. 2. Observe SLA clock badge.
Expected Result: SLA countdown timer pauses and displays 'PAUSED' badge.
Actual Result: SLA clock paused instantly upon state transition.

Test Objective: Verify Billing / Account requests auto-route to Billing Queue.
Preconditions: Ticket submitted with request type 'Billing / Account Issue'.
Test Steps: 1. Submit ticket. 2. Check JSM queue assignment.
Expected Result: Ticket automatically lands in '05. Billing & Finance Ops' queue.
Actual Result: Ticket routed to Billing Queue correctly.
Notes: JSM queue routing rule operating correctly.

Test Objective: Verify Internal Notes remain hidden from customer portal view.
Preconditions: Agent posts a yellow internal note on ticket NS-1001.
Test Steps: 1. Log into customer portal as customer. 2. View ticket NS-1001 details.
Expected Result: Internal note is completely invisible on customer portal page.
Actual Result: Internal note hidden from customer view.

Test Objective: Verify Analytics Expense Export button handles null category fields.
Preconditions: Expense dataset containing NULL values in expense_category column.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Expense Analytics. 2. Select 'Q2 2026'. 3. Click 'Export as CSV'.
Expected Result: CSV file downloads containing formatted rows with empty strings for null categories.
Actual Result: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error page displayed due to NullPointerException.
Notes: Uncaught NullPointerException in CSV export module. Logged BUG-002.

Test Objective: Verify mandatory Root Cause selection prior to setting ticket status to Resolved.
Preconditions: Agent attempting to resolve ticket NS-1002.
Test Steps: 1. Select status 'Resolved'. 2. Leave Root Cause dropdown empty. 3. Click Save.
Expected Result: Transition blocked with error 'Root Cause is required before resolving ticket'.
Actual Result: Transition blocked as expected.

Test Objective: Verify SQL database relational integrity and foreign key enforcement.
Preconditions: SQLite/PostgreSQL database loaded with `schema.sql`.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to insert ticket with invalid `customer_id = 'CUST-999'`.
Expected Result: Database rejects insert with Foreign Key Constraint Violation error.
Actual Result: FK constraint violation error raised.

Test Objective: Verify execution of SQL Analytical Queries.
Preconditions: Database seeded with `sample-data.sql`.
Test Steps: 1. Execute Query 1 through Query 25 from `queries.sql`.
Expected Result: All 25 queries execute without syntax error in under 500ms and return correct aggregated data.
Actual Result: All 25 queries executed cleanly returning accurate business analysis metrics.

Test Objective: Verify Canned Response Macros populate agent comment box.
Preconditions: Agent responding to browser cache corruption ticket.
Test Steps: 1. Select macro `/canned-browser-clear` in agent comment editor.
Expected Result: Comment editor populates instantly with step-by-step browser cache clearing instructions.
Actual Result: Macro populated comment text correctly.

Test Objective: Verify Inventory Dashboard widget renders correctly on Safari browser.
Preconditions: macOS Safari 17.4 browser session.
Test Steps: 1. Open Inventory Sync Dashboard in Safari.
Expected Result: Dashboard widget loads and renders inventory telemetry graphs.
Actual Result: Widget container displays blank white screen; JS console shows SyntaxError.
Notes: Uncompiled private JS class field syntax incompatible with Safari 17.4. Logged BUG-003.

Test Objective: Verify automated Slack/Email alert on 50% P1 SLA elapsed time.
Preconditions: Unassigned P1 ticket active for 60 minutes.
Test Steps: 1. Simulate 60 minute time lapse. 2. Inspect `#support-p1-escalations` Slack channel.
Expected Result: Automated alert message posted to Slack channel and email dispatched to Support Lead.
Actual Result: Alert posted and email dispatched as expected.
Notes: SLA threshold automation rule operating correctly.

Test Objective: Verify Role-Based Access Control isolates organization ticket visibility.
Preconditions: B2B Admin from Acme Corp (CUST-001) logged into portal.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to 'Organization Requests'. 2. Search for tickets.
Expected Result: Admin can view tickets belonging to Acme Corp, but zero tickets from Apex Logistics (CUST-002).
Actual Result: Strict tenant isolation observed; no cross-tenant leakage.

Test Objective: Verify `ticket_status_history` logs state transitions accurately.
Preconditions: Ticket NS-1001 updated from Open to In Progress.
Test Steps: 1. Query `ticket_status_history` table for `ticket_id = 'NS-1001'`.
Expected Result: Table contains audit row recording old_status 'Open', new_status 'In Progress', agent_id, and timestamp.
Actual Result: Audit trail record created correctly.

Test Objective: Verify Calendar Scheduling widget parses dates across Daylight Saving Time transitions.
Preconditions: Appointment scheduled for November 2026 (DST transition window).
Test Steps: 1. Create calendar appointment for Nov 3, 2026 at 10:00 AM MT. 2. View calendar widget.
Expected Result: Appointment displays at 10:00 AM local time.
Actual Result: Appointment displays 1 hour earlier at 09:00 AM due to UTC offset shift error.
Notes: Timezone offset calculation error on November dates. Logged BUG-004.

Test Objective: Verify customer portal response time under standard load.
Preconditions: Network monitoring tool active.
Test Steps: 1. Submit new support ticket form on portal. 2. Measure page response time.
Expected Result: Page submission completes and returns confirmation in < 1.5 seconds.
Actual Result: Submission response returned in 820ms.

Test Objective: Verify database schema cascading delete integrity.
Preconditions: Test record in `customers` table with linked `users` and `accounts`.
Test Steps: 1. Delete test customer row. 2. Query `users` and `accounts` tables for deleted customer_id.
Expected Result: Linked user and account records are automatically deleted via `ON DELETE CASCADE` without leaving orphaned records.
Actual Result: Cascading delete executed cleanly; zero orphaned records.
